Maya: Heads-up — I found a mismatch in the API ref for /v1/generate: the header example shows `Authorization` capitalized but our runtime expects lower-case `authorization` in the SSE sample. Can we standardize?
Santiago: ugh, good catch. Which file/line?
Maya: docs/reference/generate.md — under the SSE section, the curl example uses `-H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"`. Also the Ruby SDK snippet uses `client.generate_stream` but the actual method is `client.stream_generate` (old name), so the snippet errors.
Jin: I can update the Ruby snippet — was there a PR opened?
Maya: not yet, wanted to confirm approach first. Two small changes: header casing in examples, and fix Ruby method + add a minimal example that handles SSE frames.
Olivia: QA flagged flaky tests because our integration harness expects `authorization` header in lowercase for signed requests. Docs mismatch caused confusion for a new eng.
Santiago: Let's do one PR that: 1) normalizes header casing in all curl/js/python/ruby examples to `authorization`, 2) updates Ruby snippet to `stream_generate`, and 3) adds a note about SSE vs sync endpoints with a short snippet showing event parsing. Keep changes small.
Maya: Sounds good. Jin, can you take Ruby + add a tiny SSE parser example like:
```ruby
client.stream_generate(model: "rwd-1") do |event|
  next unless event.type == :data
  puts event.data
end
```
Make sure to add a short comment about handling `:
` split frames.
Jin: Yep. I'll open a draft PR and ping here. Will also run the docs linter.
ReleaseBot: PR 4821 created by Jin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 (WIP)
Maya: Thanks! I'll scan for other examples with `Authorization:` and do a sweep.
Santiago: One more: update the auth header explanation page to mention header keys are case-insensitive per HTTP but our test harness normalizes to lower-case so examples should use `authorization` to avoid confusion. Short blurb and link to the auth page.
Olivia: After PR lands, I'll run the post-merge smoke tests that validate examples in CI.
Jin: Draft PR updated: replaced `Authorization` -> `authorization` in the SSE section, fixed Ruby method, added SSE parser snippet, and added a one-line note on header normalization.
Maya: Awesome. Can you also add a small unit test that checks the docs code blocks parse (we already have a utility for that)?
Jin: Yup — added a tiny test that lints code fence for Ruby method name.
ReleaseBot: PR 4821 updated — ready for review.
Santiago: Reviewing now, will leave a couple of inline nits about wording.
Maya: LGTM after nits, thanks.
Olivia: Merged and CI passed. :tada:
Maya: Nice. Filing a quick follow-up to double-check SDK snippets repo mirrors. If anything else pops up I'll post here. :eyes:
